definitions.explanation: An electronic game played on a console, computer, or mobile device.
A competitive activity or single unit in a match (as in tennis).

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がゲームばかりしている。
examples.english: The child does nothing but play video games.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいゲームを{買|か}った。
このゲームは{面白|おもしろ}くて、{何時間|なんじかん}でも{遊|あそ}べる。
examples.english: This game is interesting and you can play it for hours.

notes:
USAGE: In Japanese, ゲーム most commonly refers to video games. For traditional games or board games, specific terms are often used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ゲームをする/{遊|あそ}ぶ (to play a game)
・ゲームソフト (game software)
・ゲーム{機|き} (game console)
・ゲームセンター (arcade)
・オンラインゲーム (online game)
・ボードゲーム (board game)
・カードゲーム (card game)

RELATED:
・{試合|しあい} (match, game in sports)
・{遊|あそ}び (play, games in general)
